findings.title: Missing Trusted Publisher registration for some packages produces a partial, dependency-skewed release
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Dropping NPM_TOKEN makes every package depend on its own Trusted Publisher registration (which SKILL.md lists as deferred), so a partial publish with dependents pinned to missing siblings is plausible; the cited code is accurate.

findings.title: Floating npm@^11.5.1 install runs unvetted code inside the id-token: write publish job
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The floating npm install bypasses the repo's pnpm minimumReleaseAge (pnpm-workspace.yaml:21 confirmed) and runs in the id-token job; this PR introduces it.

findings.title: OIDC path not taken by the actual publisher, so every publish fails closed
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculative claim that pnpm/changesets won't use the upgraded npm's OIDC path; the cited lines don't establish the mechanism, and the finding concedes it was not verified.
